_comment: Future blog/notes index. Append objects of shape { title, slug, date (YYYY-MM-DD), summary, url } to surface entries in the Writing section. The build script renders these into the POSTS sentinel; while empty, the SSR empty-state card stays in place.

posts.title: Why I Built Sharding
posts.summary: Two AI sessions agree on an interface, then one quietly drifts from it - and nobody notices until integration. Sharding makes the contract external and frozen, and catches the drift mechanically, the way a type checker catches an error.

posts.title: Teaching ccmcp Which Claude Code It's Running Against
posts.summary: Claude Code ships fast and quietly reshapes its own internals. My MCP manager used to bake those assumptions in as constants. v0.18.0 makes it detect the installed version and adapt — in one place.
